Rugged tablet — 10.1″ — Windows 11 Pro

Tuga W10

The full desktop experience. Anywhere.

£649 Includes VAT — free UK delivery

The W10 is the full desktop experience in a rugged package. A 10.1 inch FHD display, Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and a 128GB SSD run Windows 11 Pro without compromise. The port selection is what sets it apart: USB-C, USB-A, HDMI and RJ45 Ethernet for direct connections to plant, panels and network gear that has never seen Wi-Fi. Sealed to IP67, with a fingerprint sensor and pogo pin dock connector. Optional 2D barcode scanner and UHF reader variants are available.
